# C2G Logistics

> C2G Logistics is Ghana's leading China-to-Ghana importation and logistics platform. We help individuals and businesses buy products from China and ship them to Ghana via air or sea freight.

## What We Do

C2G Logistics provides end-to-end importation services from China to Ghana. Our services include:

- **Buy For Me Service**: We purchase products on your behalf from Chinese marketplaces (1688, Taobao, Pinduoduo, Alibaba, AliExpress) and ship them to Ghana.
- **China Warehouse Address**: Every customer gets a personal warehouse address in Guangzhou, China. Ship your purchases there and we consolidate and forward to Ghana.
- **Air Freight**: Fast delivery (7–16 days) for urgent, lightweight, or time-sensitive shipments.
- **Sea Freight**: Affordable bulk shipping (50–60 days) for large orders, wholesale, and business imports.
- **C2G Mall**: An online marketplace where customers can browse and buy products sourced directly from China, with delivery to Ghana included.
- **Package Tracking**: Real-time satellite tracking of shipments from China warehouse to Ghana delivery.
- **Mini Importation Platform**: Tools for WhatsApp-based resellers and mini importers to manage orders, customers, inventory, and profits.

## Who We Serve

- Individual shoppers who want to buy products from China
- Mini importers and WhatsApp resellers in Ghana
- Small and medium businesses importing goods for retail
- Wholesalers and bulk buyers
- Anyone in Ghana looking for affordable products from China

## Platform Updates — The New C2G

C2G recently launched the biggest update in its history, making importing from China faster, more flexible, and more transparent than ever.

### C2G Wallet

The C2G Wallet simplifies payments. Instead of making a separate Mobile Money payment for every order, package registration, or shipping invoice, customers top up their wallet once and use the balance anywhere on C2G. Every payment is deducted automatically — no repeated payment authorizations, faster checkout, and a much smoother experience.

### Smart Link Detection

Ordering from Chinese marketplaces is now easier. When copying product links from 1688, Taobao, or Pinduoduo, customers no longer need to manually remove extra Chinese text. Simply paste everything exactly as copied from the supplier's app. C2G automatically detects and extracts the correct product link. No editing, no cleaning, no hassle.

### Reservations (New Shipping System)

All items must now be reserved before they are shipped from China. A flat Reservation Deposit of GH₵200 is required for each reservation, regardless of shipping method (Air Normal, Air Express, or Sea). This deposit is NOT an extra charge — it becomes part of the final shipping invoice.

- If the final shipping fee is less than GH₵200, the difference is automatically refunded to the customer's C2G Wallet.
- If the final shipping fee exceeds GH₵200, the customer simply tops up the remaining balance.

Customers can combine multiple items (Buy For Me orders, registered packages, etc.) into a single reservation, paying only one GH₵200 deposit. This system ensures every shipment leaving China has a shipping commitment, allowing C2G to provide reliable service to all customers.

### Choose Your Shipping Mode Later

Customers no longer choose their shipping method when placing a Buy For Me order, shopping on C2G Mall, or registering a package. Instead, shipping method selection happens when creating a reservation. This gives much greater flexibility — after items arrive at the warehouse, customers can decide to ship some by Air Express, others by Air Normal, and larger items by Sea.

### Package Registration Requires Images

Every registered package now requires product images during registration. This helps the warehouse team identify items faster and improves processing accuracy.

### Summary of Improvements

- Faster payments via the C2G Wallet
- Smarter ordering with automatic link detection
- More flexible shipping with the reservation system
- Better package identification with required images
- Greater transparency and predictability in shipping costs
